messages:
Keisha: Morning all — quick async highlights + asks for today: 1) infra rollout warmup for demo, 2) doc checklist for KV cache edge cases, 3) oncall coverage this afternoon. Drop what you did / blockers / today + any asks below. :sun_with_face:

Liam: Did: merged config PR for continuous batching. Blocker: seeing 500s on staging when seq len > 1024. Today: debugging kernel selector with @Sanjay. Can someone rerun the perf job for staging?

Sanjay: On it — scheduling a perf run now and will pin logs. Also ping: needs a quick review on PR #412 (runtime: batching fallback) — @Ella could you sanity-check the release notes snippet?

Ella: Will do a quick pass, expect comments in ~30m. Added a short doc entry about KV cache invalidation behavior in edge cases.

Marta: Heads up — customer demo at 3pm PT. Can we ensure the dedicated pool is warmed and no cold-starts? @Nora can you bump pool to 2x for the demo window?

Nora: Done — scheduled an autoscale override 14:50-15:30 PT to keep 2 instances warm. I'll watch latency and CPU.

Ben: Ask: can someone paste the curl for the test endpoint? Need to run it from corp VPN.

Keisha: curl snippet (use corp VPN / region header):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "X-Region: us-west-2" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"test"}'
```
Swap region header if you hit eu or apac.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Production rollout 2026-03-17T10:24Z to redwood-alpha succeeded — 2 instances replaced. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay: Perf job result: latency spike repro'd with seq=2048 on gpu-c3-8, small log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:40Z WARN kernel_selector: fallback to generic for layer 7
```
We'll try forcing the alternate kernel and rerun.

Liam: If I disappear after noon I'm in a deep-dive; please assign PR review to @Keisha so it doesn't block the pipeline.

Keisha: Copy that. @Ella @Marta any other asks? If not I'll compile this into ops-notes and add the demo warmup checklist.

Marta: :thumbsup: Nothing else. Good luck with the demo — ping me if you need warm-up sequences or sample prompts.

Nora: Monitoring dashboards look stable at the moment. I'll post a short update at 15:35 PT with final warmup stats.

Ben: Thanks — running the curl test now, will report if I see errors.
